name: Calibrated opposite-direction rank cycles

a.description: Forward HDL-rank cycle: most ranks are locally concordant, but the upper-TC group wraps around to low HDL ranks.

b.description: Backward HDL-rank cycle: a lower-TC group receives high HDL ranks, while the upper-TC group remains paired with relatively high HDL.

calibration: For each direction, bracket and bisect the integer cycle displacement using the empirical mean TC/HDL after enforcing HDL <= TC. Select the closest ratio among the evaluated displacements and nearby integer displacements. Non-HDL threshold fractions are not calibration objectives.
constraint_repair: Process TC in ascending order. If its assigned HDL exceeds TC, exchange that HDL with the smallest HDL still assigned to an unprocessed row.
interpretation: Two deliberately stylized latent-group assignment assumptions, not clinically validated dependence models. Both preserve the supplied marginal arrays exactly.
